scope: Deterministic, fail-closed validation of every external package in the pnpm production and optional dependency graph across all workspace importers and supported platforms

priorDefect.failureMode: The release license gate depended on mutable pnpm package-store index files and could not produce a complete license decision even though the frozen dependency graph was installed.

implementedControls: parse only a bounded pnpm version-9 lockfile with YAML aliases disabled
start from every importer production and optional dependency while excluding development-only and workspace-link packages
traverse lockfile snapshots to include transitive and cross-platform optional packages independent of the current host installation
require exact registry-shaped identities and sha512 integrity for every external package
reject non-registry link, workspace, file, Git, HTTP, and HTTPS dependency references
bind the sorted reviewed inventory to the SHA-256 of the complete lockfile
fail closed on missing, extra, unsorted, malformed, stale, or unapproved inventory entries
permit only explicitly reviewed exact license strings and compound expressions
validate offline without reading pnpm's mutable package-store index or contacting a registry
run the offline license validator inside both pnpm verify and the supply-chain CI job

inventoryGenerationBoundary.purpose: Generate a review candidate after an authorized dependency change; generation does not approve a license.
networkControls: exact package name and version reads from one fixed registry

inventory.reciprocalLicenseNotice: THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md records sharp/libvips LGPL-3.0-or-later distribution obligations; release artifacts must retain package license files and the SBOM.

covered: complete production and optional graph derivation with development/workspace exclusion, direct-URL rejection, and required sha512 integrity
deterministic sorted inventory generation and validation

sbom.interpretation: The SBOM is an independent component/provenance artifact. Its current pnpm output does not contain package license fields and is not the license decision source.

operationalImpact.failurePolicy: Dependency or lockfile drift blocks verification until exact registry evidence and every new license expression receive maintainer review.
operationalImpact.rollback: Do not restore the package-store-index-dependent validator. Correct the lockfile or regenerate and review the inventory; do not bypass the fail-closed gate.

limitations: Registry metadata is point-in-time evidence and does not replace review of shipped license texts, notices, or source-offer obligations.
This control is not legal advice and does not establish compatibility for every downstream packaging or distribution model.
The authoritative hosted CI workflow has not run because no remote publication or push was authorized.
No release, publication, production deployment, or production-readiness result is claimed.
